title: Common knowledge
text:
Title: Common knowledge

Defining something as common knowledge can differ based on circumstances because there are variations in what is considered common knowledge amongst different groups. 
The variation can come from the time period, culture, population, class, age, demographic, and other circumstances. For example, the Fifth Amendment to the 
United States Constitution might be considered common knowledge among people residing in the United States of a certain age, but cannot be considered common knowledge when considering the general population of other countries.
